prior_italian_phd_scholarship.description: Those who have already received a scholarship for a doctoral program in Italy are not eligible for a doctoral scholarship.
prior_italian_phd_scholarship.source: Art. 4 – Characteristics and amount of the doctoral scholarship, para. 5(a)

earlier_session_accepted_position.description: Candidates who have accepted a position in one session may not participate in subsequent sessions.
earlier_session_accepted_position.source: Selection process divided into three separate sessions; candidates accepting a position in one session cannot participate in later sessions

italian_degree.description: Master's degree (Laurea Magistrale), Laurea specialistica, or pre-1999 Diploma di Laurea with minimum final grade of 95/110.

conditional_admission.requirement: Weighted average of at least 25/30 on exams taken

foreign_degree.requirement: Second-level academic degree under Bologna Process or Master's degree granting access to doctoral studies in country of origin (EQF Level 8)

conditional_admission.requirement: Minimum GPA on exams taken as indicated in Annex 2

first_cycle_degree.italian: Upload complete study plan to 'Educational background' section of Apply with date and final grade of degree (Art. 8, para. 1, letter b)

foreign.degree: Bachelor's degree (EQF Level 6) corresponding to Italian Laurea, issued by accredited/recognized foreign university granting access to Master's (EQF Level 7)
foreign.transcript: Complete transcript of records, scanned front and back, listing all exams taken with grades and credits earned (Art. 8, para. 1, letter b, ii)

master_degree.italian_already_obtained: Enter complete study plan in 'Educational background' section of Apply with date and final grade
master_degree.italian_not_obtained: Upload study plan in 'Educational background' section including exams taken up to application date
master_degree.foreign_already_obtained: Master's degree (EQF Level 7) equivalent to Italian Laurea Magistrale + Complete transcript of records, scanned front and back
master_degree.foreign_not_obtained: Most up-to-date transcript of records, scanned front and back, including all exams with grades and credits; if in final year, attach most up-to-date transcript with final/provisional GPA

mandatory: Identification document (front and back copies of valid ID with photo and signature)

Bachelor's degree: Italian - complete study plan in 'Educational background' with date and final grade; Foreign - degree diploma + complete transcript of records (front/back) with all exams, grades, credits

Master's degree: Italian (obtained) - complete study plan in 'Educational background' with date and final grade; Italian (not obtained) - study plan with exams taken up to application date; Foreign (obtained) - degree diploma + complete transcript of records; Foreign (not obtained) - most up-to-date transcript with grades/credits
English language certification B2 (if already obtained, from Annex 4 list)
strongly_recommended: Declaration of Value or Certificate of Comparability and/or Verification issued by CIMEA – ENIC NARIC Italia for first- and second-cycle degrees
Diploma Supplement (DS) for first- and second-cycle degrees (for degrees awarded in Bologna Process countries)
Official document indicating expected completion date of foreign degree (if in final year)
For UK, Australia, New Zealand, China, France, and countries with academic/vocational distinction: refer to Annex 6
optional: Letters of recommendation from university professors, researchers, or representatives of institutions/businesses
Publications (type, authors, date - entered in Apply portal)
Any other supporting documents (other degrees, awards, post-graduate schools, professional experience, etc.)

declaration_of_value.wording: Declaration of Value or Certificate of Comparability and/or Verification issued by CIMEA – ENIC NARIC Italia for first- and second-cycle degrees
declaration_of_value.note: Strongly recommended for those who already hold a degree; not mandatory but strongly advised

diploma_supplement.wording: Diploma Supplement (DS) for first- and second-cycle degrees (for degrees awarded in countries participating in the Bologna Process)
diploma_supplement.note: Strongly recommended for those who already hold a degree; not mandatory but strongly advised

application_process.registration: First-time applicants must register; PoliTo graduates/students access via Teaching Portal with existing credentials

payment_sequence.step_2: Pay the €30 fee online via Apply platform using one of: (a) credit card / PagoPA (immediate payment), (b) pre-printed payment notice MAV on PagoPA (deferred payment)
payment_sequence.step_3: Payment must be made within the application deadline
payment_sequence.step_4: Application is validly completed ONLY after payment AND submission
payment_sequence.note: Once payment is made, application cannot be modified

application_process.submission_cutoff: Application deadline (15 Feb 2027, 14:00 Europe/Rome for third session); payment must be completed by this deadline

project_specific_funded.description: Candidates interested in positions with predefined research topic and/or apprenticeship positions must: (1) carefully read scholarship description with topic and required skills, (2) contact scientific supervisor if needed, (3) select up to maximum 5 options via online Apply procedure
project_specific_funded.note: If no positions without scholarship are available for the program, withdrawal from all scholarships/apprenticeship positions results in exclusion from competition (except surplus research fellow positions)

regular: Positions with scholarship and open research topic
Positions with scholarship for specific research topic
Positions without scholarship and open research topic
Positions without scholarship for specific research topic
reserved: Positions for recipients of scholarships awarded by foreign governments
Positions for Project POLITO FOR REFUGEES (1 position in second session)
Positions for Project CONFLICT ZONES (2 positions in second session, one Pratt Legacy-funded)
Positions for Research Fellows (half of regular spots per program, rounded up)

components: Regional fee of EDISU Piemonte (tassa regionale EDISU)
enrolment_fees.note: Amounts to be published in Student Tuition Fee Regulations for 2026/2027 academic year; amounts paid are non-refundable

enrolment_deadlines.note: Enrolment is finalized only upon completion of both online and in-person phases

third_session_reserved_positions.note: Reserved positions for third session are not explicitly detailed separately in the call; the reserved position categories (foreign government scholarships, POLITO FOR REFUGEES, CONFLICT ZONES, international initiatives, Research Fellows) apply across sessions as available. POLITO FOR REFUGEES (1 position) and CONFLICT ZONES (2 positions) are explicitly noted for second session. Third session reserved positions would follow the same categories based on availability.
